name: 1 Apr 1967

references.label: Belfast Gazette issue 2382 (Alteration of boundary of Urban County District of Downpatrick (confirmation))
references.note: 16 Sep 1966, page 330. Made 6 Sep 1966. In force: 1 Apr 1967. Confirms Down County Council's order of 16 Jun 1966 extending Downpatrick UD.

references.label: Ministry of Development Provisional Order Confirmation (Bangor Borough Extension) Act (Northern Ireland) 1966 (1966 c. ii)
references.note: Local Act confirming the Bangor Borough (Extension) Order (Northern Ireland) 1966. Royal Assent 6 Dec 1966 (Belfast Gazette issue 2394, 9 Dec 1966, page 465). Appointed day 1 Apr 1967, as printed in the confirmed Order. Bangor borough extended; its Princetown, Dufferin, Castle, Clifton and Ballyholme wards were extended.

references.label: New Towns (Municipal Functions - Craigavon) Order (Northern Ireland) 1967 (S.R. & O. 1967 No. 57)
references.note: Made under section 28 of the New Towns Act (Northern Ireland) 1965; notice in Belfast Gazette issue 2411, 31 Mar 1967, page 111. From 1 Apr 1967 the Craigavon Development Commission acts as an urban district council for the whole of Lurgan Rural District except Ballyblagh, Knocknashane, Tirsogue and part of Toberhewny, which are added to the Borough of Lurgan; that area is known as the Urban District of Craigavon. The new town was designated by the New Town Designation Order (Northern Ireland) 1965 (Belfast Gazette issue 2317, 6 Aug 1965, page 274), which did not itself alter district boundaries.

references.label: Census of Population 1971: Preliminary Report
references.note: Changes in administrative areas: Co. Armagh (1)-(2), Lurgan RD to Lurgan MB and Lurgan RD re-designated Craigavon UD; Co. Down (1)-(2), East Down RD to Downpatrick UD and North Down RD to Bangor MB; all 1 Apr 1967.

references.label: Urban Districts Boundaries (Procedure) Order (Northern Ireland) 1936 (S.R. & O. 1936 No. 170)
references.note: Made 9 Dec 1936 by the Ministry of Home Affairs under section 24 of the Local Government Act (Northern Ireland) 1934: the local inquiry and public notices required before a county council could make an order altering or defining the boundary of an urban county district. The Downpatrick boundary order confirmed in 1966 recites compliance with it (Belfast Gazette, issue 2382, 16 Sep 1966).

references.label: Belfast Gazette issue 2382 (Downpatrick Urban District (boundary alteration))
references.note: 16 Sep 1966, page 331. Made 6 Sep 1966. In force: 1 Apr 1967. District boundary altered: Rural District of East Down; places named: Downpatrick Urban District, Ardglass, Ballynahinch, Castlewellan, Crossgar, Downpatrick Rural; by Ministry of Development; made 6 September 1966; in force 1 April 1967; under 24 of the Local Government Act (Northern Ireland) 1934.

approximateSegments.note: Some lines on this map are approximate: parts of the Armagh urban district boundary are traced from the map deposited with the 1946 Order (about 20 m); parts of the Bangor borough boundary are taken from the map of the 1966 Order, registered on the OSNI six-inch Edition 5 sheets (about 20 m); parts of the Larne borough boundary are traced from the 1956 extension map (about 25 m); Newtownabbey's inland line follows whole townlands read from a small-scale scheme map and is not confirmed. They are drawn dotted on the map.
